explore.goal: Explore this bookshop like a careful first-time buyer: browse the catalog, add books to the cart, change quantities, remove one, check out, then visit the account, orders, and sign-in pages. Report every defect you have evidence of.
explore.summary: Explored all primary user flows of the Bookshelf web application, including catalog browsing, cart management, checkout, account settings, order history, and sign-in pages. Discovered multiple defects including broken cart total calculations, incorrect item removal from the cart, broken 'Add to cart' functionality for specific books, unrendered UI template tokens, order date formatting bugs, and broken navigation links. While basic page routing works, core e-commerce features suffer from severe functional and data integrity defects.

steps.summary: Explored Account, Orders, Sign-in/out, and Help pages. Found Account profile save fails to persist Display name, Orders page count mismatch (3 claimed, 2 shown), and Help nav link points to misspelled '/hlep' causing a 404 page.

findings.title: Unrendered template token {{userName}} displayed in home page greeting
findings.expected: Greeting text should display a proper user name or default greeting without unrendered template tokens like {{userName}}.
findings.actual: Welcome, {{userName}}! You have 0 item(s) in your cart.

findings.title: Negative in-stock quantity shown for Neuromancer in catalog
findings.expected: In stock quantity should be a non-negative integer (e.g., 0 or greater).

findings.title: 'Add to cart' button for Dune is unresponsive / broken
findings.expected: Tapping 'Add to cart' for Dune should add Dune to the cart.
findings.actual: Tapping 'Add to cart' for Dune has no visible effect and does not add the book to the cart.
reproduction: Click 'Add to cart' next to Dune

findings.title: Cart total does not update when item quantity is changed
findings.expected: Cart total should update to $39.25 when item quantity is modified.
findings.actual: Cart total shows "$25.25" after increasing Hyperion quantity to 2 (Hyperion line total $28.00 + Solaris line total $11.25 should equal $39.25).
reproduction: Add Hyperion ($14.00) and Solaris ($11.25) to cart
Click "+" to increase Hyperion quantity to 2

findings.title: "Remove" button in cart removes the wrong item
findings.expected: Clicking "Remove Solaris" should remove Solaris from the cart.
findings.actual: Clicking "Remove Solaris" removed Hyperion from the cart, leaving Solaris in the cart.
reproduction: Add Hyperion and Solaris to cart

findings.title: Misspelled "Recieve" on checkout page
findings.expected: Text should be spelled correctly as "Receive the newsletter".
findings.actual: Text next to checkbox reads "Recieve the newsletter".

findings.title: Order confirmation displays Unix epoch default dates (1970-01-01 and 1969-12-29)
findings.expected: Order placed date and estimated delivery date should be plausible current dates, not 1970-01-01 / 1969-12-29.
findings.actual: Order confirmation status states "Order #1042 placed on 1970-01-01 for $11.25. Estimated delivery: 1969-12-29."
reproduction: Enter shipping address and click "Place order"

findings.title: Account profile save claims success but fails to update display name
findings.expected: The display name field should retain and show the saved value ("Ada Lovelace Updated") after saving the profile.
findings.actual: Status shows "Profile saved." but the Display name textbox value reverts to "Ada Lovelace" instead of keeping "Ada Lovelace Updated".
reproduction: Type "Ada Lovelace Updated" into Display name textbox

findings.title: Order count states 3 orders but only 2 orders are displayed
findings.expected: The order count should match the number of orders listed (3 listed orders).
findings.actual: Order count states "You have 3 orders." but only 2 orders (#1041 and #1042) are listed in the order history.
reproduction: Observe "You have 3 orders." status and the listed orders

findings.title: "Help" navigation link points to misspelled "/hlep" URL resulting in 404 Page Not Found
findings.expected: The "Help" link should point to a valid help page (e.g. "/help").
findings.actual: The "Help" link points to "/hlep" which displays "Page not found - There is nothing at /hlep."
reproduction: Click the "Help" link in the header navigation
